properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 19 at 12:25AM CDT until September 19 at 3:00AM CDT by NWS La Crosse WI
properties.description:
At 1225 AM CDT, local law enforcement reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain. A mudslide was reported on Highway 76 west of
Caledonia near Badger Creek. Water going over the roadway at Beaver
Creek Valley State Park. Between 4 and 6.5 inches of rain have
fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1.5 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Caledonia, Houston, Hokah, Brownsville, Mound Prairie, Money Creek,
Reno, Yucatan, Sheldon, Black Hammer, Highway 44 And Sanden Road,
Beaver Creek Valley State Park, Dun Romin Park Campground, County
14 And White Tail Road, Freeburg, County Roads 3 And 24, Perkins
and County Roads 15 And 4.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.areaDesc: Citrus, FL; Levy, FL; Marion, FL
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 18 at 8:56PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Citrus, Levy and Marion
Counties.

.The Withlacoochee River at Dunnellon has been steadily rising since
July, and on September 15 reached flood stage. The cause of the high
water along the Withlacoochee River at Dunnellon is due to excessive
hydrilla growth (from the river bottom to the water surface) along a
4.5 mile stretch of river between US 41 and Lake Rousseau.  The
hydrilla is acting like a dam and holding water back, causing water
levels to rise.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Withlacoochee at US 41 Dunnellon.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 28.2 feet, Docks and boat ramps flood along the river
in Citrus and Marion counties.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:45 PM EDT Friday the stage was 28.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 28.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain above flood stage
until further notice.
- Flood stage is 28.2 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 28.2
feet on 10/02/1979.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
